name: kogarashi
description: Split-screen blog theme. A fixed midnight image panel on one side, a scrolling grid of post cards on the other, cobalt accents.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees. Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.

panel_image.title: Panel image
panel_image.description: Image behind the side panel. Leave empty for the midnight gradient.

panel_side.title: Panel side
panel_side.description: Which side of the screen the fixed panel sits on (desktop). On mobile the panel always comes first.

grid_columns.title: Grid columns
grid_columns.description: Post card columns on the home page. Three columns apply on wide screens only (1400 px and up).

show_excerpts.title: Show excerpts
show_excerpts.description: Print the short excerpt under each post title on cards and list rows.
